A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/Staige

Platform pays for cameras and shares revenue

StaigePremium

Staige One AG, formerly soccerwatch.tv · Essen, Germany · founded 2017 · pivoted · staige.com/en/staige-sport · last verified 2026-09-19

Platform pays for cameras and shares revenueFixed multi-lensEvidence BQuote onlyGoing-concern note in the FY2025 accounts

A fixed 180-degree AI camera bolted to a floodlight pole that streams amateur matches to the Staige TV platform, sells virtual tickets and sponsor banners on the club's behalf, and feeds a coaching app.

For German-speaking amateur and semi-professional clubs that want every home match streamed without a volunteer behind a camera, and that have a sponsor or a regional bank willing to fund the hardware. Federations and broadcasters that want a turnkey lower-league feed are the second audience.

Staige exists because soccerwatch.tv proved in 2017 that German amateur clubs would let a robot camera film them if the stream came with sponsor money attached, and the K2 panorama camera plus the Staige TV paywall turned that into a repeatable product with more than 250,000 events recorded staige-06. It matters now because the listed parent Staige One AG has spent 2025 and 2026 moving its capital and its engineers into Staige for Industries, a security and infrastructure video business, while the sport segment sits flat at about €2.0 million revenue and camera deliveries run behind schedule staige-05, staige-07. It tells you that the pure sponsor-funded amateur streaming model, on its own, has struggled to carry a listed company, and that the survivors in this space will be the ones with a second revenue engine or a very lean cost base.

Price band Camera pricing on request, typically sponsor or bank funded; €1.50 net per paid pay-per-view access retained by Staige staige-01

Italy The 2025 annual report lists Germany, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, the USA and China as markets and does not mention Italy, and an earlier regional profile named Italy only as an expansion target staige-05, staige-10.

The verdict

Look if You run a club in Germany, Austria, Switzerland or Luxembourg with a permanent floodlit main pitch, a fixed 230V supply at height and a sponsor or regional bank prepared to cover the camera, and your main aim is an unattended weekly stream plus a paywall, with tracking data a low priority. Look also if you are a small federation or regional broadcaster that wants dozens of venues streamed under one platform contract with sponsor and pay-per-view tooling already built.

Skip if You are outside the DACH region, you want a portable device you can carry to away games, or you need positional and event data on top of video, because Staige Coach is a video tagging tool and the K2X is a fixed install. Skip also if you need the vendor to be around and investing in sport for the next five years without question, because the parent company's own auditor has flagged going concern uncertainty and management is directing capital to the industrial video business.

Watch-outs

  • The 2025 consolidated accounts carry an auditor's note of material uncertainty about the group's ability to continue as a going concern, with financing dependent on shareholder loans from adesso SE and Malo Industriebeteiligungen staige-05.
  • Sport segment revenue was flat at €2.04 million in 2025 and management says deliveries of the new camera generation to licence customers are running behind schedule staige-05, staige-08.
  • Camera purchase and subscription prices are not published, so every deal is negotiated through a consultation call and a sponsor or funding partner staige-02, staige-03.
  • The StaigeTV viewer app on iOS carries a 2.6 out of 5 rating from 69 reviews, with complaints about streams failing to start and cropped horizontal playback, and its last update listed is December 2024 staige-12.
  • Staige retains €1.50 net on every paid pay-per-view access and settles paywall credits to the club only once or twice a year staige-01.
  • Full match downloads require a separate desktop download tool for Mac or Windows, with no one-click export in the web app staige-01.
  • Headcount fell from 49.5 average employees in H1 2025 to 37 in H1 2026, and the year-end 2025 count was 29 FTE, so support capacity for sport customers is thinner than it was staige-05, staige-07.

Products

  • Staige K2X (camera). AI camera with 180-degree panorama and Full HD live output, marketed as mobile with a five-minute setup and sold to clubs as a floodlight-pole install. staige-02
  • Staige K2 (camera). Fixed six-lens panorama camera, weatherproof and tamper resistant, permanently installed at about seven metres. staige-14
  • Staige TV (platform). Viewer platform on web and apps with live streams, highlights, pay-per-view and season tickets. staige-01
  • Staige Coach (app). Coaching app for drawing, tagging and sharing clips to players, with cloud access to all recordings. staige-03
  • Backstaige (platform). Club dashboard for schedules, sponsor banners, paywall settings and downloads. staige-01
  • Staige Pro (platform). Scalable camera and platform offer for leagues, federations and broadcasters. staige-04

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
Staige is built for the fixed home ground of an amateur or semi-professional club, with the camera mounted at about seven metres on a floodlight pole and a permanent 230V feed, and it covers football first with volleyball, handball, basketball, ice hockey and equestrian as secondary sports staige-01, staige-02. The product answers the streaming and monetisation question well and the coaching question adequately. It does not answer the away-match question at all, since even the K2X, marketed as portable and ready in five minutes, is sold to clubs as a floodlight-pole install in the club material staige-02, staige-03.
Capture quality
The K2 records and streams in Full HD from six lenses stitched into a 180-degree panorama, and the annual report describes a new camera generation with resolution moved from 8K to 16K source capture for the ClipMyHorse.TV equestrian deployment staige-01, staige-05, staige-14. Output to viewers remains HD, and each 130-minute game consumes 8 to 12 GB upstream staige-01. Public sample footage on Staige TV shows a competent broadcast-style virtual camera at amateur grounds, with the usual panorama softness at the far touchline.
Automation accuracy
The system tracks players and ball in real time and produces an AI-directed virtual camera, with alternative streams for training, analysis and full 180-degree views selectable per event staige-01. Staige publishes no accuracy figures and no independent test exists in public, so the evidence is limited to the platform's operating history of more than 250,000 recorded events and the RTL Luxembourg and CA Osasuna academy references staige-03, staige-06. Highlight generation is automatic with a tagging tool for manual correction staige-01.
Multi-angle and stitching
Stitching happens inside the single camera head across six sensors, so there is no field calibration for the club to do and no second unit to align staige-01. Multiple output perspectives are all cut from the same single panorama. There is no public support for combining two K2 units or an external PTZ into one production.
Latency and live readiness
Live streaming is the core use case, with simultaneous output to Staige TV, YouTube and Twitch, pre-roll advertising and up to six sponsor banners inserted in the stream staige-01, staige-03. Staige publishes no glass-to-glass latency figure. The company learned the hard way about scale after a server failure during an FC Schalke 04 test match with more than 40,000 viewers, which it says drove infrastructure changes staige-10.
Reliability and resilience
The camera is weatherproof and tamper resistant, draws 29W while streaming and 10W in standby, and runs unattended on a schedule staige-01, staige-14. The main public signal on reliability is the viewer app, where iOS reviewers report streams that fail to start and slow loading, summarised by one reviewer as a world-class idea with lower-league execution staige-12. Vendor headcount cuts through 2025 and 2026 are a second risk to operational responsiveness staige-05, staige-07.
Portability and install
Installation of the K2 takes one to two hours on a floodlight pole at roughly seven metres and requires permanent mains power and a wired or strong wireless uplink staige-01, staige-03. The K2X page promises a five-minute mobile setup, yet the same site sells it to clubs as a pole-mounted install, and no battery, tripod or LTE specification is published for the mobile use case staige-02. Treat Staige as a fixed system until the vendor shows you a portable kit in the field.
Connectivity and bandwidth
Staige requires 8 to 12 Mbps sustained upload per camera and produces 8 to 12 GB of data per game, which rules out many rural club grounds without a dedicated line staige-01. All processing and storage is cloud based in Frankfurt and the Netherlands, so there is no server hardware at the club staige-01. No offline recording fallback is described in public material.
Workflow and UX
Clubs manage schedules, banners and paywall settings in the Backstaige dashboard, viewers use Staige TV on web and mobile, and coaches use Staige Coach for drawing, tagging and sharing clips to players' phones staige-01, staige-03. Full-match download needs a separate desktop tool staige-01. The viewer app's 2.6 rating suggests the fan-facing side lags the club-facing side staige-12.
Analysis layer
Staige Coach offers video review with drawing tools, tagging and clip sharing, endorsed in vendor material by Borussia Dortmund and the CA Osasuna academy staige-03. There is no positional tracking data, no event data feed and no xG-style metrics offered to clubs in public material. For a club that wants data, this is a stream first and a coaching tool second.
Integrations
Streams push to YouTube and Twitch alongside Staige TV, and broadcasters such as RTL Luxembourg, FAN.at and ClipMyHorse.TV take Staige feeds into their own services staige-01. There is no published API, no XML export for Hudl or Sportscode, and no listed integration with club management or ticketing software. Integration therefore means distribution endpoints, with no data exchange.
Distribution and OTT
Distribution is Staige's strongest layer, with a hosted OTT platform, pay-per-view and season tickets, sponsor banner management for up to six partners, pre-roll ads and social highlight clips with sponsor logos staige-01, staige-03. Staige keeps €1.50 net per paid access for processing and payment provider costs and credits the club once or twice a year staige-01. The club keeps its sponsorship revenue in full under the Volksbank funding programme description staige-13.
Data access and ownership
Clubs can download complete games through the desktop tool and share clips from Staige Coach, and recordings are stored on European servers staige-01. The published material does not state who owns the footage, how long it is retained, or whether Staige may reuse it for model training, and the company's 2025 report describes data from more than 250,000 events as a company asset staige-06. Ask for the licence terms in writing before signing.
Privacy and compliance
Staige publishes a sample privacy notice for facilities, lights a red signal lamp during recording, permanently blurs areas such as residential buildings or footpaths on request, and stores data in Frankfurt and the Netherlands staige-01. The parent company positions its industrial product around privacy by design, no facial recognition and EU AI Act alignment, which the sport product inherits at platform level staige-07. There is no published consent workflow for minors on the pitch, which matters for youth football.
Security
The company is majority owned by adesso SE and describes enterprise-grade scalability and certified IT security standards through that relationship, with hosting in the EU staige-04, staige-01. No ISO 27001 certificate, penetration test summary or SOC report for the sport platform is public. Not assessable beyond these statements from public sources.
Pricing and TCO
No purchase, lease or subscription price for the K2 or K2X is published; clubs are routed to a consultation and to sponsor or bank funding, with the Volksbank eG Gestalterbank programme giving four clubs a year a free system with storage for about 120 games annually staige-02, staige-13. The annual report describes sale-and-leaseback financing of cameras on about 32-month terms, which points to a multi-year commitment staige-05. Known recurring costs are the €1.50 net per paid access and the club's own upload line staige-01.
Support and service
Club support runs through a dedicated email and a German phone line in Essen, with installation done by Staige or partners in one to two hours staige-02, staige-03. Headcount has fallen to 29 FTE at year-end 2025 and 37 on average in H1 2026, with a restructured sales organisation, so response capacity is thinner than it was staige-05, staige-07. No public SLA is published.
Company health and roadmap
Staige One AG is listed in Frankfurt and Düsseldorf, reported €2.0 million revenue and a €4.2 million net loss for 2025, raised €2.1 million in a Q2 2025 capital increase mostly taken up by adesso SE and Malo Industriebeteiligungen, and took a further €0.6 million credit line in March 2026 and about €0.85 million more in shareholder loans by August 2026 staige-06, staige-08. H1 2026 revenue was €1.03 million with EBITDA of minus €0.47 million, improved from minus €1.51 million, and management targets €3.0 to 3.5 million revenue and break-even EBITDA for the full year, driven by Staige for Industries with sport flat staige-07. The auditor's going concern note and the flat sport line are the two facts to weigh staige-05.
Evidence and references
Named references include Borussia Dortmund as shareholder and user, the CA Osasuna academy, RTL Luxembourg, FAN.at and ClipMyHorse.TV, plus more than 200 club partnerships and 1,200 games streamed weekly in an earlier regional profile staige-03, staige-10. The homepage claims more than 1,200 installed systems across all business lines staige-04. No independent field test or federation evaluation is public.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
Vendor testimonials from BVB's Lars Ricken and the Osasuna academy's Imanol Lobo praise real-time analysis and direct sharing with players staige-03. Independent coach reviews are absent, and the public sentiment that exists concerns the fan app, where playback problems dominate staige-12. Not assessable for the coaching tool from independent public sources.
Edge versus cloud
The camera stitches and encodes on the device, then everything else runs in the cloud, including the AI direction, highlights, storage and delivery staige-01. There is no local recording option described for grounds without an uplink. The industrial product line is edge based, and the annual report references a newer camera generation, so more on-device processing may arrive in sport, though no date is given staige-05, staige-07.
Accessibility and languages
The website, apps and support operate in German and English, and the viewer app is listed in English only on the App Store staige-01, staige-12. Broadcasters in Luxembourg and Austria use the platform, which shows multi-market operation inside the German-speaking area staige-01. No Italian, Spanish or French interface is documented.
Upgrade path
Existing licence customers are being moved to the new camera generation during 2026, with deliveries behind plan staige-08. A club can grow from a single K2 to Staige Pro deployments for leagues and broadcasters under the same platform staige-04. There is no published trade-in or firmware roadmap for clubs.
Differentiators worth testing
Test the paywall and sponsor banner workflow end to end, including how quickly a virtual ticket purchase resolves to a playing stream on a phone, since that is where Staige claims to earn the club money staige-01. Test the Staige Coach clip-to-player flow with a youth squad and check the consent handling. Ask for the current delivery date of the new camera generation and the contract term behind any sponsor-funded offer staige-05, staige-08.

Company

Ownership and funding Staige One AG (HRB 36279, Amtsgericht Essen) is listed on the Frankfurt and Düsseldorf exchanges, with adesso SE as principal shareholder and Malo Industriebeteiligungen GmbH as the second anchor, and Borussia Dortmund as strategic partner and shareholder with CFO Thomas Treß on the supervisory board staige-06, staige-11. Share capital rose in steps from €250,000 in 2021 to €7.57 million in May 2025 through repeated capital increases, including a 2023 IPO that raised about €8 million and a €2.1 million increase in Q2 2025 staige-10, staige-11, staige-06. Financing in 2026 has come from shareholder loans and an adesso credit line, with no recourse to the capital market staige-08.

Financials FY2025 revenue €2.0 million (flat), EBITDA minus €2.5 million, net loss €4.2 million including a €1.0 million deferred tax write-down; sport segment revenue €2.036 million with €1.708 million from Germany and €311,000 from the rest of Europe staige-05, staige-06. H1 2026 revenue €1.031 million, EBITDA minus €0.47 million, net loss €0.83 million; FY2026 guidance €3.0 to 3.5 million revenue and EBITDA between minus €0.2 and plus €0.2 million staige-07. The auditor flagged material uncertainty about going concern in the 2025 accounts staige-05.

Scale, company-stated More than 250,000 sports events recorded as of May 2026 staige-06; more than 1,200 installed systems across all lines per the homepage in September 2026 staige-04; 29 FTE at end 2025 and 37 average employees in H1 2026 staige-05, staige-07; an earlier regional profile cited more than 200 club partnerships, 1,200 games streamed weekly and 120,000 games broadcast staige-10.

Not verified

  • Purchase, lease or subscription price of the K2 and K2X camera for a club, and the standard contract term.
  • Current number of installed sport cameras and active clubs, since the company reports events and not camera counts.
  • Whether the K2X is available as a battery and LTE powered portable kit, and its specifications in that form.
  • Footage ownership, retention period and any reuse rights Staige holds over club recordings.
  • Any Italian club, reseller or federation deployment.
  • Glass-to-glass streaming latency and any published uptime figures.
  • Independent coach or analyst reviews of Staige Coach.
  • The 2017 founding year refers to the soccerwatch.tv operating company AISportsWatch GmbH and is taken from general knowledge; the listed parent Staige One AG appears in the register with capital of €250,000 in April 2021 staige-11.
